title: Paloma and the Vector
author: Rafael Amberdale
blurb: Casper Dravenmoor, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
